role_context: An existing enablement function reporting to the COO, with several dozen automations and shared Claude Slack integrations. The proposed approach starts by maintaining and understanding that estate, not replacing it.

responsibilities.requirement: Operate, repair and retire the automation portfolio
responsibilities.owned_action: Directed working-state, action-boundary and review controls in Servari; developed CareerAgent's receipt-bound lifecycle; requested workflow inspection when an app was not useful.
responsibilities.concrete_mechanism: Servari baselines and snapshots selected files for keep-or-revert decisions. CareerAgent separates attempts, authorisation and receipt reconciliation and stops on an unknown outcome. A recorded Slack responder incident led to a recovery check and runbook update.
responsibilities.useful_result: Recoverable work and observable completion, rather than treating an agent's final message as proof.
responsibilities.material_gap: Operating Epoch's multi-user production estate is a new responsibility. Transfer begins with a service inventory, incident/runbook review and existing owner's handover.

responsibilities.requirement: Build useful workflows with operations, communications and research colleagues
responsibilities.owned_action: Defined the bid manager's required decisions and challenged disconnected discovery, staffing and proposal outputs. Turned career source material into reviewable application artifacts. Developed individual context-first coaching.
responsibilities.concrete_mechanism: Shared opportunity context, parallel specialist analysis, dependent synthesis, roster-ID validation and section-specific schema-checked output.
responsibilities.useful_result: A person receives staffing gaps, assumptions, CV actions and next steps, not several unrelated answers.
responsibilities.prospective_transfer: Pilot real tasks with their owners and representative inputs; keep communications release and research interpretation with the appropriate human reviewers.

responsibilities.owned_action: Asked whether tender discovery was useful against actual organisational capability; challenged invented operational figures; requested used-versus-leftover service inventory and completion of one working flow before adding another platform.
responsibilities.concrete_mechanism: Inspect the real workflow and dependencies before implementation; use baseline/keep-or-revert checks for a defined change.
responsibilities.useful_result: A decision tied to an operational need and checkable output instead of feature volume.
responsibilities.material_gap: No measured historical ROI portfolio is claimed. First-90-day plan specifies baselines, full-cycle effort and maintenance cost.

responsibilities.requirement: Run shared Claude Slack tools, integrations, skills and prompts; review models and spend
responsibilities.owned_action: I have worked on agents that respond through Slack, not only a separate demonstration interface. I wanted the roles and existing workflows connected before expanding the next product. My acceptance constraint was direct: 'the fix needs to be future proof not only now'. That was a requirement to preserve working behaviour, not permission to change everything around it.
responsibilities.concrete_mechanism: The inspected bridge handles Slack events, thread delivery, role lookup and response routing. Role briefs and a neutral working directory bound the context for company-facing replies. The current source can select CLI, SDK, OpenAI-compatible or Gemini backends. It includes selected-agent canaries and an explicit CLI rollback path, so a new engine can be introduced without immediately moving every role.
responsibilities.useful_result: Model, context, permissions and tool execution can be examined as separate layers.
responsibilities.material_gap: Direct production administration of Claude Tag in Slack is not evidenced. Proposed work begins with existing app ownership, scopes, dependencies and support channels.

responsibilities.requirement: Onboard, coach and support staff comfortably
responsibilities.owned_action: Adapted context-first AI guidance to an individual consulting task, then proposed supervised real-work procedures. Gave practical Quantum/UNall and supplier guidance and trained two project support colleagues.
responsibilities.concrete_mechanism: Work-specific context, clear procedures, independent trial, feedback and follow-up; escalate systems errors through the responsible team.
responsibilities.useful_result: An independently tried method and a concrete next-pilot plan; colleagues received practical process support.
responsibilities.prospective_transfer: A low-pressure help channel, beginner-friendly examples, task-based onboarding and coaching that ends with the colleague running and checking their own task.

responsibilities.requirement: Document maintenance and handover; keep organisational ownership of access
responsibilities.owned_action: Required living module blueprints, current implementation state and durable Claude/Codex handoffs; defined survival records and recovery checks.
responsibilities.concrete_mechanism: Shared Markdown working record; Servari active-work, work-log, gate and session records; claim/file hashes and exact reviewed artifact identity in CareerAgent.
responsibilities.useful_result: The next agent or reviewer can find decisions, changed files, checks and the next action.
responsibilities.prospective_transfer: Maintain an organisation-owned service account/access inventory and test runbooks with a second person. That organisational account handover is proposed, not a past Epoch achievement.

responsibilities.requirement: Maintain dashboard and explain who benefited and by how much
responsibilities.owned_action: Rejected an unexplained operational count and an impressive shell that did not connect work. Implemented workflow status and metric-based review; assembled a scoped provider-usage audit for this portfolio.
responsibilities.concrete_mechanism: Complete/partial/failed specialist status; baseline versus later checks; provider counter semantics and audit coverage remain separate.
responsibilities.useful_result: A reviewer can distinguish activity, measured behaviour and unsupported outcomes.
responsibilities.material_gap: No historical measured staff-hours savings or company-wide adoption rate. Proposed dashboard captures users, full-cycle effort, failure/correction rate, cost and last review.
